settings.heading: The Next Standard in Footwear Craft.
settings.subtext: Factory laces were made to save margins. laceyaan laces are engineered to honor design. Slow shuttle-loomed weaves, 10mm chunky braids, 3M nocturnal reflective cords, and solid CNC naval brass aglets.
